components.name: Metric Selector
components.description: Underlined comparison metric, controlled through aria-pressed.
components.css: .ds-metrics{display:flex;gap:24px;border-bottom:1px solid #c2c9be}.ds-metrics button{position:relative;border:0;background:none;color:var(--muted,#596862);font:12px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','PingFang SC',sans-serif;padding:8px 0 11px;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap}.ds-metrics button[aria-pressed=true]{color:var(--ink,#293f3a);font-weight:600}.ds-metrics button[aria-pressed=true]:after{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:-1px;height:2px;background:var(--ink,#293f3a)}.ds-metrics button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--red,#a94737);outline-offset:5px}

components.name: Category Navigation
components.description: Ruled serif category rows with selected indentation.
components.css: .ds-categories{display:flex;flex-direction:column;max-width:280px}.ds-categories button{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;min-height:59px;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid #bbc7b6;background:none;text-align:left;padding:8px 0;color:#3d5248;cursor:pointer;transition:padding .4s,color .3s}.ds-categories span{font:400 22px var(--serif,'Noto Serif SC',serif)}.ds-categories small{font:11px sans-serif;color:#52664e}.ds-categories button[aria-pressed=true]{color:var(--red,#a94737);padding-left:12px}.ds-categories button[aria-pressed=true] span{font-weight:600}.ds-categories button:hover{color:var(--red,#a94737)}.ds-categories button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--red,#a94737);outline-offset:5px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-categories button{transition:none}}

components.css: .ds-details{border-top:1px solid var(--line,#cbd1c7);color:var(--muted,#596862);font:12px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','PingFang SC',sans-serif}.ds-details summary{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;list-style:none;cursor:pointer;padding:22px 0}.ds-details summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.ds-details[open] summary svg{transform:rotate(45deg)}.ds-details summary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--red,#a94737);outline-offset:5px}.ds-details p{line-height:2.1;margin:0 0 8px}

narrative.northStar: Classical Chinese ink wash, modern interaction.
narrative.overview: Approved visual world: classical Chinese ink wash, modern interaction. Code-led implementation; no approved image comp. Three top-level research views share one quiet shell: imagery atlas, poet emotion, and poet clustering. The imagery navigation has its own near-opaque rice-paper layer for reliable contrast over every scene.
keyCharacteristics: Sparse rules and continuous unframed landscape
Linked imagery, emotion evidence, and diction-cluster views
dos: Do preserve real raster artwork and vermilion selection.
Do preserve mobile stacking, keyboard interaction, and reduced motion.
donts: Don't introduce nested cards, shadows, or decorative SVG scenery.
Don't present lexicon scores or dimensionality reduction as definitive literary judgment.
